# The commands each required job exists to run, by workflow and job, one a line as
# `<workflow file>#<job id>: <command>`. Each is a whole logical line of a run: script of its job,
# its continuation lines joined by one space, with nothing added: no argument, no redirection, no
# `|| true`. The one suffix allowed is ` || status=$?` before an `exit "$status"` later in the script.
# The workflow policy test (.github/scripts/policy.test.mjs) requires each line in a step of its job
# that runs whenever the job does, with no condition in a job without a watch and with the watch's
# own in an instrument job, and that may not fail quietly: deleting the step, skipping it, changing
# the line or letting it continue on error fails the policy. Every job that builds in release proves
# its overflow checks. A job's every required check is named in .github/required-checks.txt, and
# every required job is named here.

ci.yml#rust: cargo-nextest nextest list --locked --workspace --run-ignored all --message-format json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/tests.json"
ci.yml#rust: node .github/scripts/test-list.mjs nextest "$RUNNER_TEMP/tests.json"
ci.yml#rust: cargo-nextest nextest run --locked --workspace --profile ci
ci.yml#rust: cargo test --locked --workspace --doc -- --list > "$RUNNER_TEMP/doctests.txt" 2>&1
